WITH site_mesh_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    s.zoneregistry,
    s.entrystat,
    AVG(sm.facetfaces) as site_avg_faces
  FROM sites s
  LEFT JOIN scanmesh sm ON s.zoneregistry = sm.zoneref
  GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat
),
overall_baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(site_avg_faces) as baseline
  FROM site_mesh_averages
),
status_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    entrystat,
    AVG(site_avg_faces) as status_avg_faces
  FROM site_mesh_averages
  WHERE entrystat IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY entrystat
),
kept_sites AS (
  SELECT 
    sma.site_avg_faces,
    sa.status_avg_faces,
    ob.baseline
  FROM site_mesh_averages sma
  JOIN status_averages sa ON sma.entrystat = sa.entrystat
  CROSS JOIN overall_baseline ob
  WHERE sma.site_avg_faces > sa.status_avg_faces
)
SELECT
  AVG(site_avg_faces) as avg_faces,
  AVG(site_avg_faces - baseline) as avg_exceed_baseline,
  AVG(site_avg_faces - status_avg_faces) as avg_exceed_status
FROM kept_sites
